value.description: HITL ticket. One question at a time via the grilling and decision-mapping skills. The default ticket type.
value.name: Grilling

value.description: HITL ticket. Build a cheap, rough, concrete artifact for the human to react to. Raises the fidelity of the discussion.
value.name: Prototype

value.description: A step inside an Issue, not an outcome. Tasks carry no verification answers - they inherit from the Issue above. A Task with no parent Issue escapes the check entirely; that is a smell worth seeing, not a gap to paper over.
value.name: Task

value.description: The buildable description of a thing - the last stop before code. A Spec cannot close until it says how the result will be checked and what observation would prove it does NOT work. After this point that answer costs a rebuild.
value.name: Spec

value.description: A real piece of player-facing change. On close an Issue must say how the result was checked and what observation would prove it does not work. Nothing to check in the game is a legitimate answer - choose None. Tasks beneath an Issue inherit these answers.
value.name: Issue

value.description: AFK ticket. Read docs, APIs, or local corpora and produce a linked markdown summary. No human in the loop.
value.name: Research

value.description: A set of related decisions driven toward a destination. A Map may close with decisions still open, provided it says WHY IT STOPPED.
value.name: Map

value.description: Cheap intake. No promise, no structure. An Idea closes one of two ways: it became real work (say what, and link it), or we decided against it (say why).
value.name: Idea

value.description: A step inside a Map, not an outcome. Carries no verification answers - inherits from the Map above, exactly as Task inherits from Issue.
value.name: Wayfinder Task

value.description: A group of issues delivering one outcome. It does not carry verification answers; those live on its issues, where a single check is meaningful. On close it states what it delivered in player terms, in a sentence.
value.name: Epic

value.description: Server-side data for a set of steps to be tested.
value.name: Test Case

value.description: Tracks test activities for a specific milestone or release.
value.name: Test Plan

value.description: Tracks test activites for a specific feature, requirement, or user story.
value.name: Test Suite
